about_the_game:
Welcome to Cooked Out, where the kitchen gets competitive, and the eggplants get adventurous! Dive into this vibrant, multiplayer party game, available on desktop and on mobile. Here's what makes Cooked Out your next gaming addiction.

Unique Gameplay :
Control a quirky eggplant character in a world where food is not just for eating – it's for battling! Use your wit, strategy, and quick reflexes to outlast your opponents in a variety of deliciously dangerous arenas.

Dynamic Arenas :
Fight in four whimsical environments – Spinach Soup, Donut Glaze, Stew, and Melted Cheese. Each arena has its own set of challenges and hazards. Avoid boiling pots and sizzling Tabasco drops to stay in the game!

Headbutt Mechanics :
Your primary weapon? A powerful headbutt! Charge it up for extra power and send your opponents flying. The farther they go, the better your chances of winning.

Powerful Boosters :
Collect a variety of boosters on the battlefield. Speed past opponents, inflate with the Balloon for a bumper effect, pack a punch with the Big Punch, or cause a mess with the Cream Pie. Each booster adds a unique twist to the gameplay.

The Puck :
Watch out for the puck! This wildcard can change the course of the game in an instant, keeping every round fresh and unpredictable.

Multiplayer Mayhem :
Play against friends or random foes online. The fast-paced multiplayer action ensures two games are never the same.

Winning and Losing :
Whether you're the last eggplant standing or the first one cooked, each game is filled with laughter, cheers, and loads of fun.

Ready to join the culinary chaos? Download Cooked Out and become the ultimate eggplant champion in this hilarious, action-packed party game!

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1400 or equivalent / Intel Core i3-7100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or equivalent / Intel Core i5-7600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
